house.description: School board required to include student representation.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring a school board to include student representation; amending Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 123B.09, subdivision 1b.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 123B.09, subdivision 1b, is amended to read:

Subd. 1b.
Student representation.
The school board [-is encouraged to-][+ must+] adopt a process to include student representation to advise the school board.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for the 2026-2027 school year and later. +]
